title: अष्टात्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 138 · Bhima carries his family through the forest

summary.en: Bhima carries his mother and brothers swiftly through the dark forest, breaking trees as he goes. When they lie exhausted under a great tree, he laments to see the noble Kunti and his brothers sleeping on the bare ground, and keeps watch while they sleep.
summary.kn: ಭೀಮನು ತಾಯಿ ಸಹೋದರರನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತು ಮರಗಳನ್ನು ಮುರಿಯುತ್ತಾ ಕತ್ತಲ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಸಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದಣಿದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮರದಡಿ ಮಲಗಿದ ಕುಂತಿ ಸಹೋದರರನ್ನು ಬರಿನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಂಡು ವಿಲಪಿಸಿ, ಅವರು ನಿದ್ರಿಸುವಾಗ ಕಾವಲು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: भीम माता और भाइयों को उठाकर वृक्षों को तोड़ते हुए अँधेरे वन में तेज़ी से चलते हैं। थककर विशाल वृक्ष के नीचे लेटे कुन्ती और भाइयों को नंगी भूमि पर सोते देख वे विलाप करते हैं और उनके सोते समय पहरा देते हैं।
summary.te: భీముడు తల్లిని, సోదరులను మోస్తూ చెట్లను విరుస్తూ చీకటి అడవిలో వేగంగా సాగుతాడు. అలసి పెద్ద చెట్టు కింద పడుకున్న కుంతిని, సోదరులను వట్టి నేలపై చూసి విలపించి, వారు నిద్రిస్తుండగా కాపలా కాస్తాడు.
summary.ta: பீமன் தாயையும் சகோதரர்களையும் சுமந்தபடி மரங்களை முறித்துக்கொண்டு இருண்ட காட்டில் விரைகிறான். களைத்துப் பெரிய மரத்தடியில் படுத்த குந்தியையும் சகோதரர்களையும் வெறுந்தரையில் கண்டு புலம்பி, அவர்கள் உறங்கும்போது காவல் காக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ഇരുണ്ട കാട്ടിലൂടെ മരങ്ങൾ ഒടിച്ചുകൊണ്ട് ഭീമൻ അമ്മയെയും സഹോദരന്മാരെയും വേഗത്തിൽ ചുമന്നുകൊണ്ടുപോകുന്നു. ക്ഷീണിതരായി ഒരു വലിയ വൃക്ഷച്ചുവട്ടിൽ കിടക്കുമ്പോൾ, ഉന്നതകുലജയായ കുന്തിയും സഹോദരന്മാരും നഗ്നഭൂമിയിൽ ഉറങ്ങുന്നത് കണ്ട് ഭീമൻ വിലപിക്കുന്നു; അവർ ഉറങ്ങുമ്പോൾ അദ്ദേഹം കാവലിരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.138; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तेन विक्रमता तूर्णमूरुवेगसमीरितम् ।
प्रववावनिलो राजञ्शुचिशुक्रागमे यथा ॥

meaning.en: As he strode swiftly, O king, the wind raised by the force of his thighs blew as in the season of early summer.

verses.text:
स मृद्नन्पुष्पितांश्चैव फलितांश्च वनस्पतीन् ।
आरुजन्दारुगुल्मांश्च पथस्तस्य समीपजान् ॥

meaning.en: He crushed flowering and fruiting trees and broke the bushes and shrubs growing near his path.

verses.text:
तथा वृक्षान्भञ्जमानो जगामामितविक्रमः ।
तस्य वेगेन पाण्डूनां मूर्च्छेव समजायत ॥

meaning.en: Smashing trees as he went, he of boundless prowess moved on, and at his speed the Pandavas nearly swooned.

verses.text:
असकृच्चापि संतीर्य दूरपारं भुजप्लवैः ।
पथि प्रच्छन्नमासेदुर्धार्तराष्ट्रभयात्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Several times they crossed wide waters by swimming with their arms, and they kept hidden along the way for fear of Dhritarashtra's sons.

verses.text:
कृच्छ्रेण मातरं त्वेकां सुकुमारीं यशस्विनीम् ।
अवहत्तत्र पृष्ठेन रोधःसु विषमेषु च ॥

meaning.en: With difficulty Bhima carried his mother alone, the delicate and renowned lady, on his back over rough banks.

verses.text:
आगमंस्ते वनोद्देशमल्पमूलफलोदकम् ।
क्रूरपक्षिमृगं घोरं सायाह्ने भरतर्षभाः ॥

meaning.en: At evening, bulls of the Bharata line, they reached a dreadful part of the forest with little fruit, root or water, full of cruel birds and beasts.

verses.text:
घोरा समभवत्संध्या दारुणा मृगपक्षिणः ।
अप्रकाशा दिशः सर्वा वातैरासन्ननार्तवैः ॥

meaning.en: The twilight turned terrible, the beasts and birds fierce, and all directions were dim, with winds blowing out of season.

verses.text:
ते श्रमेण च कौरव्यास्तृष्णया च प्रपीडिताः ।
नाशक्नुवंस्तदा गन्तुं निद्रया च प्रवृद्धया ॥

meaning.en: The Kauravas, worn out by effort and thirst and heavy with sleep, could go no farther.

verses.text:
ततो भीमो वनं घोरं प्रविश्य विजनं महत् ।
न्यग्रोधं विपुलच्छायं रमणीयमुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima entered the great, lonely, frightful forest and came to a lovely banyan tree with wide shade.

verses.text:
तत्र निक्षिप्य तान्सर्वानुवाच भरतर्षभः ।
पानीयं मृगयामीह विश्रमध्वमिति प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: There he set them all down and, that bull of the Bharatas, said: 'I will look for water. Rest here, my lord.

verses.text:
एते रुवन्ति मधुरं सारसा जलचारिणः ।
ध्रुवमत्र जलस्थायो महानिति मतिर्मम ॥

meaning.en: 'These water birds, the cranes, are calling sweetly; surely there is a large pool here, I think.'

verses.text:
अनुज्ञातः स गच्छेति भ्रात्रा ज्येष्ठेन भारत ।
जगाम तत्र यत्र स्म रुवन्ति जलचारिणः ॥

meaning.en: Told 'Go' by his eldest brother, Bhima went where the water birds were crying.

verses.text:
स तत्र पीत्वा पानीयं स्नात्वा च भरतर्षभ ।
उत्तरीयेण पानीयमाजहार तदा नृप ॥

meaning.en: There he drank, bathed, bull of the Bharatas, and carried water back in his upper cloth, O king.

verses.text:
गव्यूतिमात्रादागत्य त्वरितो मातरं प्रति ।
स सुप्तां मातरं दृष्ट्वा भ्रातॄंश्च वसुधातले ।
भृशं दुःखपरीतात्मा विललाप वृकोदरः ॥

meaning.en: Coming back a short distance to his mother, he saw her and his brothers asleep on the ground, and Vrikodara lamented, heart full of grief.

verses.text:
शयनेषु परार्ध्येषु ये पुरा वारणावते ।
नाधिजग्मुस्तदा निद्रां तेऽद्य सुप्ता महीतले ॥

meaning.en: 'Those who once could not sleep on the finest beds in Varanavata sleep today on bare earth.

verses.text:
स्वसारं वसुदेवस्य शत्रुसंघावमर्दिनः ।
कुन्तिभोजसुतां कुन्तीं सर्वलक्षणपूजिताम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Here is Kunti, sister of Vasudeva, destroyer of enemy hosts, daughter of Kuntibhoja, honored for all her marks of fortune.

verses.text:
स्नुषां विचित्रवीर्यस्य भार्यां पाण्डोर्महात्मनः ।
प्रासादशयनां नित्यं पुण्डरीकान्तरप्रभाम् ॥

meaning.en: 'She is the daughter-in-law of Vichitravirya, wife of great Pandu, always sleeping in palaces, with a glow like the heart of a lotus.

verses.text:
सुकुमारतरां स्त्रीणां महार्हशयनोचिताम् ।
शयानां पश्यताद्येह पृथिव्यामतथोचिताम् ॥

meaning.en: 'More delicate than other women, used to costly beds, look at her lying today on the ground, unfit for it.

verses.text:
धर्मादिन्द्राच्च वायोश्च सुषुवे या सुतानिमान् ।
सेयं भूमौ परिश्रान्ता शेते ह्यद्यातथोचिता ॥

meaning.en: 'She bore these sons to Dharma, Indra and Vayu, and now, worn out, she lies on the earth where she does not belong.

verses.text:
किं नु दुःखतरं शक्यं मया द्रष्टुमतः परम् ।
योऽहमद्य नरव्याघ्रान्सुप्तान्पश्यामि भूतले ॥

meaning.en: 'What greater sorrow could I see than this, that I see these tigers among men asleep on the ground?

verses.text:
त्रिषु लोकेषु यद्राज्यं धर्मविद्योऽर्हते नृपः ।
सोऽयं भूमौ परिश्रान्तः शेते प्राकृतवत्कथम् ॥

meaning.en: 'This man deserves the kingdom of the three worlds and knows dharma, yet he lies exhausted on the earth like a commoner.

verses.text:
अयं नीलाम्बुदश्यामो नरेष्वप्रतिमो भुवि ।
शेते प्राकृतवद्भूमावतो दुःखतरं नु किम् ॥

meaning.en: 'This one, dark as a rain cloud, unequaled among men on earth, sleeps like a commoner on the ground; what could be sadder?

verses.text:
अश्विनाविव देवानां याविमौ रूपसंपदा ।
तौ प्राकृतवदद्येमौ प्रसुप्तौ धरणीतले ॥

meaning.en: 'And these two, like the Ashvins among the gods in beauty, now lie asleep on the ground like ordinary men.

verses.text:
ज्ञातयो यस्य नैव स्युर्विषमाः कुलपांसनाः ।
स जीवेत्सुसुखं लोके ग्रामे द्रुम इवैकजः ॥

meaning.en: 'He who has no wicked kinsmen to shame his family lives very happily in the world, like a tree standing alone in a village.

verses.text:
एको वृक्षो हि यो ग्रामे भवेत्पर्णफलान्वितः ।
चैत्यो भवति निर्ज्ञातिरर्चनीयः सुपूजितः ॥

meaning.en: 'A single tree in a village, with leaves and fruit, becomes a shrine and is honored and worshiped, though it has no kin.

verses.text:
येषां च बहवः शूरा ज्ञातयो धर्मसंश्रिताः ।
ते जीवन्ति सुखं लोके भवन्ति च निरामयाः ॥

meaning.en: 'Those who have many brave kinsmen who keep to dharma live happily in the world and stay free of trouble.

verses.text:
बलवन्तः समृद्धार्था मित्रबान्धवनन्दनाः ।
जीवन्त्यन्योन्यमाश्रित्य द्रुमाः काननजा इव ॥

meaning.en: 'Strong, rich in resources, delighting friends and relatives, they live relying on one another like trees in a forest.

verses.text:
वयं तु धृतराष्ट्रेण सपुत्रेण दुरात्मना ।
विवासिता न दग्धाश्च कथंचित्तस्य शासनात् ॥

meaning.en: 'But we were exiled by evil Dhritarashtra and his sons, and by his command we were somehow not burned.

verses.text:
तस्मान्मुक्ता वयं दाहादिमं वृक्षमुपाश्रिताः ।
कां दिशं प्रतिपत्स्यामः प्राप्ताः क्लेशमनुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Free from the fire, we now shelter under this tree. Which way shall we go, having reached such great hardship?

verses.text:
नातिदूरे च नगरं वनादस्माद्धि लक्षये ।
जागर्तव्ये स्वपन्तीमे हन्त जागर्म्यहं स्वयम् ॥

meaning.en: 'I see that a city is not far from this forest. They must stay alert, but they sleep; very well, I will keep watch myself.

verses.text:
पास्यन्तीमे जलं पश्चात्प्रतिबुद्धा जितक्लमाः ।
इति भीमो व्यवस्यैव जजागार स्वयं तदा ॥

meaning.en: 'Let them drink water later, when they wake free of weariness.' With this resolve, Bhima stayed awake himself.
